title: Creative-energy campaign film

location.extent: Complete published clip; PNG is a frame at 0.5 seconds

slide_intent: Connect an abstract promise to people and activity because viewers need to see what creative collaboration enables.
strategic_value: Scenes of makers and shared work can connect Dropbox’s expressive identity with a human purpose.
demonstration: The film alternates people, creative settings, product collaboration screens, bold headline overlays and a closing Dropbox signature on yellow.
practical_value: Compare the roles of human footage, product evidence and graphic transitions in one campaign film.

content_islands.name: People and work
content_islands.spec: Sequence individuals and groups in varied creative contexts.

content_islands.name: Product evidence
content_islands.spec: Retain the collaboration screens within the film rather than treating them as unrelated UI samples.

content_islands.name: Graphic closure
content_islands.spec: Follow the headline overlays through to the final symbol-and-name frame.
